summaries.topic: FIG commissions (framework for dividing survey fields)
summaries.summary: FIG organises its technical work into ten commissions. The technical ones relevant to survey technology are Spatial Information Management (3), Hydrography (4), Positioning and Measurement (5), Engineering Surveys (6) and Construction Economics and Management (10). The six-area grouping used in the first outline is a presentation choice and is not a published standard.
key_points: Ten commissions in total (FIG commissions page)
Commission 5 working groups for 2023-2026 include GNSS, multi-sensor systems and emerging technologies for PNT
The 6-area split in the draft outline is the assistant's own grouping
open_questions: Organise the slides by FIG commission, or keep the technology-based grouping?
Confirm the textbook table of contents supports the same split
